meta.title: MemSearch Memory
meta.description: Persistent cross-agent conversation memory: automatically summarizes each turn, supports memory recall and skill distillation, lets DSH share the same memory store with Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw / OpenCode.

panelNote: Review opens in the conversation · Install runs in the background
reviewQueued: Review for "{name}" queued — the agent will handle it next turn.
selectFile: Select a file to preview its contents (read-only).
unsupportedFile: Unsupported file type for preview (.md/.json/.txt/.toml and similar text).
openFailed: Could not open directory: {message} — please open the folder manually.

skillReviewSkill.name: Memory-recall
skillReviewSkill.description: Search MemSearch persistent memory for context relevant to your question. Use when the question could benefit from past sessions, decisions, or work in this project.
skillReviewSkill.whenToUse: The user references past work, asks what was done before, or the task could reuse earlier context. Cheap to check; costs one index search.

memoryConfigSkill.name: Memory-config
memoryConfigSkill.description: Diagnose and configure MemSearch memory behavior. For questions about MemSearch configuration, plugin summarization, PROJECT.md/USER.md maintenance, memory directories, index health, provider routing, prompt files, or migration/compatibility issues.
memoryConfigSkill.whenToUse: When the user asks to check, change, or troubleshoot MemSearch memory settings on DeepSeek Harness.

memoryToSkillSkill.name: Memory-to-skill
memoryToSkillSkill.description: Turn workflows from your MemSearch memory into reusable skills. Use when asked to create/extract/distill a skill from recently completed or past work, review skill candidates, or install distilled skills.
memoryToSkillSkill.whenToUse: When the user wants to capture a recurring workflow as a skill, review or install distilled skill candidates from .memsearch/skill-candidates/, or enable/tune background distillation.

errorDependencyMissing: MemSearch CLI not found; install memsearch on PATH or set MEMSEARCH_CMD to its executable path.
errorDependencyIncompatible: Installed memsearch CLI is incompatible with this plugin; --default-collection support is required. Upgrade memsearch core and the plugin together.
errorDshCliMissing: dsh CLI not found; enable the Desktop Manage dsh Command entry or set DSH_CLI for summarizeMode=dsh-headless.
errorPythonMissing: Python 3 not found; install Python 3 on PATH or set MEMSEARCH_PYTHON to its executable path.
